title: Staff of Max Newman's section at Bletchley Park, April 1943 to April 1945
description: Bar chart of the Newmanry's staff at six-monthly intervals: 18 in April 1943, 28 in September 1943, 93 in April 1944, 225 in September 1944 and 325 in April 1945, most of them Wrens (16, 16, 28, 180 and 273). Data: General Report on Tunny (1945), section 31B, in Tony Sale's transcript of the Newmanry history.
heading: NEWMANRY STAFF · WRENS IN BRACKETS
